method: Synthetic frozen scenarios, identical draft store and verified initial PNG per baseline/contextual_hint pair. Each model cohort has one conversation for four cases; this is not sixteen independent sessions. Actual MCP stdio, software fixtures, no private/user photos. No statement of human preference.

scoring.calls: All recorded calls except initialization/catalog; different no-write early stopping can reduce total. Some replications lost native export wire entries. Verified DB-backed file count supplies only a lower bound; do not infer unknown export call positions.
scoring.protect: Protected bottom-right mark, no changed pixel outside 8px dilation of initial new ink, no layout/recalibration, exact plain selected revision ZIP RGB; the exclusion mask is a proxy and allows intended ink blur near original lines.
scoring.focus: Correct stored ink-only gradient with nonzero upper and sharp lower anchor; no changed pixel at or below y=437. Local selected glyph alternate reported separately. No export blur.
scoring.light: Only stored photo ink light positive setting, dark site has larger mean absolute RGB change for deep ink. No focus blur or global opacity.
scoring.controls: Keep and stored_canvas gate: original r1 chosen and unchanged, no revision writes or recalibration for strict count; safe local-only blocked alternatives reported separately because user disallowed reflow/calibration, not all localized edits.
scoring.budgets: Observe all real calls; separately cut first correct output at 12. Actor summary explanations are not equivalent to calls.

focus.user_prompt: 这份作业已写在拍下来的同一张纸上。纸张远处（图的上方）的新字比旁边原有印线明显锐，像后来贴上去的；下方的字现在就好。只轻微软化远处新字的边沿，不要动原有印线、角标、排版和字色。核对画面后交付逐页 PNG 的 ZIP。

light.user_prompt: 这份已写好的作业在一张右下方较亮、左上方带点阴影的照片上。新字的颜色像横跨阴影都没有变化，看起来浮在纸面上。让新增的有色笔迹跟着纸面所在位置的明暗变化，不要统一压深或变浅，不要把笔画变糊，也别动原有印线、角标和排版。核对后交付逐页 PNG 的 ZIP。

keep.user_prompt: 这份照着纸张写好的作业现在看起来已经合适：字、印线、角标、版面和远近的效果都保留，不需要再润饰。只核对画面并把当前稿交付为逐页 PNG 的 ZIP，不新建修订。

blocked.user_prompt: 这张照片上方的新字有点过锐，我只想让上方新增字迹稍微柔一点。纸张和排版已经确认，不要重新标定纸面，不要移动或重排任何字，也不要柔化原来的印线和角标。如果不能在这些限制下做到，就交付现稿并说明原因。请交付逐页 PNG 的 ZIP。
